_note: Coordinates for automated map-pin placement (MapPin component). City/town-level entries are accurate to the settlement; precision notes flag where the real site sits within a larger city. script1 ('Inside the Terror Factory'): pakistan_training_camps for Segment 2 map, op_sindoor_nine_camps for Segment 9. script2 ('60 Hours'): mumbai_2611_sites plus the karachi reference point.

muridke.label: Muridke (Markaz-e-Taiba / Markaz Taiba)
muridke.note: City-level coordinate. Markaz Taiba compound sits on the edge of Muridke town, ~30km from Lahore.

muzaffarabad.label: Muzaffarabad (Sawai Nala & Syedna Bilal camps)
muzaffarabad.note: City-level coordinate for capital of Illegally Occupied Pakistani Kashmir. Both Op Sindoor camps here are sub-locations within/near the city.

bahawalpur.label: Bahawalpur (Markaz Subhanallah / JeM HQ)
bahawalpur.note: City-level coordinate. The struck complex (Ahmedpur Sharqia/Masjid Subhan) is a town just outside Bahawalpur proper.

kotli.label: Kotli, Illegally Occupied Pakistani Kashmir (Gulpur & Abbas camps)
kotli.note: City-level coordinate. Gulpur specifically is a village southwest of Kotli town.

bhimber.label: Bhimber, Illegally Occupied Pakistani Kashmir (Barnala camp)

sialkot.label: Sialkot (Sarjal & Mahmoona Joya camps)
sialkot.note: City-level coordinate for Sialkot city, Punjab. Do not confuse with the unrelated village 'Sialkot, Mansehra' in KP.

op_sindoor_nine_camps._note: Nine individually-named camps for Segment 9. Several share a parent city's coordinate; the map applies a small pixel offset so pins don't overlap.

markaz_subhanallah_bahawalpur.label: Markaz Subhanallah, Bahawalpur
markaz_subhanallah_bahawalpur.precision: city-level (struck site is in Ahmedpur Sharqia, just outside Bahawalpur proper)

sawai_nala_muzaffarabad.label: Sawai Nala camp, Muzaffarabad
sawai_nala_muzaffarabad.note: Officials linked this camp to planning of the April 2025 Pahalgam attack

cst_station.label: Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus (CST)
cst_station.note: Railway station, deadliest single site of the attack.

cuffe_parade_landing.label: Cuffe Parade landing points (Badhwar Park / Macchimar Nagar)
